name: Golexanolone
summary: Golexanolone, also known by the developmental code name GR-3027, is a neurosteroid medication which is under development for the treatment of hypersomnia and hepatic encephalopathy. It acts as a negative allosteric modulator of the GABAA receptor.

pharmacology.text: It acts as a negative allosteric modulator of the GABAA receptor. The medication selectively antagonizes the stimulatory actions of inhibitory neurosteroids like allopregnanolone and tetrahydrodeoxycorticosterone (THDOC) at the GABAA receptor, while not affecting the activation of the GABAA receptor by γ-aminobutyric acid (GABA).

uses.text: Golexanolone, also known by the developmental code name GR-3027, is a neurosteroid medication which is under development for the treatment of hypersomnia and hepatic encephalopathy.

fact.en: Most neurosteroids, such as allopregnanolone, boost the calming GABAA receptor. Golexanolone was designed to do the opposite and block that boost, to treat sleepiness and the brain fog of liver disease.
fact.zh: 多數神經類固醇如異孕烷醇酮會增強具鎮靜作用的 GABAA 受體。Golexanolone 則被設計成反其道而行，阻擋這種增強作用，用來治療嗜睡和肝病引起的腦霧。
fact.zhHans: 多数神经类固醇如异孕烷醇酮会增强具镇静作用的 GABAA 受体。Golexanolone 则被设计成反其道而行，阻挡这种增强作用，用来治疗嗜睡和肝病引起的脑雾。
